observations.text: Friction and walk 51058b84: one outside person's free agent ran 83 turns with no reply on a single trigger message, 2 Nov 21:36 to 3 Nov 07:11 UTC (last turn failed). Corner restore reads were refused during the run. Same area as the 27 Oct storm; changes.

Walk f0f5f3d2, outside, 3 Nov: the storm went on after the morning report. 149 more turns on 149 separate wakes, 07:11-17:01 UTC, 119 empty posts; 231 turns since 2 Nov 21:36. It stopped after the 16:34 v0.1.141 release; #3414 is not merged. Changes.

fixes.text: Stop re-waking an agent after repeated silent turns on one message and tell the person (#3414); fix corner opened 3 Nov, PR open

title: An agent is woken again and again on one message and never answers
whatHappens: A person asks once and leaves. Their agent is woken dozens of times on that same message, only re-reads status, and never posts a reply.
